svg.text: Split one raster too big for a single COG into bounded mini-COGs plus a portable GDAL VRT index — then expand it back into one virtual tile per member for distributed rst_* work
Too big to hold as one COG
— or to fit in per-task RAM
a portable GDAL lens over the tiles
lightweight VRT XML — indexes every tile
a VRT over a dynamic tile subset
The index is just standard VRT XML.
databrickslabs/geobrix · lightweight tier (pyrx) · Serverless-ready · no JAR
